maddeler.e:
أحترق (form VIII)
# أَحْتَرِقُ (ʔaḥtariqu) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# أَحْتَرِقَ (ʔaḥtariqa) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
# أَحْتَرِقْ (ʔaḥtariq) /ʔaħ.ta.riq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَقَ (iḥtaraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
